qs.s: He worked hard, wrote a clear CV and got a job in a software company, which gave him enough money to rent his own apartment. What does “get a job” mean?
qs.say: He worked hard, wrote a clear CV and got a job in a software company, which gave him enough money to rent his own apartment.
qs.vi: Anh làm việc chăm chỉ, viết CV rõ ràng và xin được việc ở một công ty phần mềm, đủ tiền thuê căn hộ riêng.
qs.why: get a job = xin được việc, tìm được việc làm.

qs.s: She passed the entrance test, went on to a top university with a scholarship, and later became a research scientist in Germany. What does “go on to” mean?
qs.say: She passed the entrance test, went on to a top university with a scholarship, and later became a research scientist in Germany.
qs.vi: Cô vượt qua bài thi đầu vào, học tiếp lên một đại học hàng đầu với học bổng, và sau này thành nhà khoa học nghiên cứu ở Đức.
qs.why: go on to + trường/trình độ = học tiếp lên.

qs.s: Airlines have raised airfares because of rising fuel costs. As a result, fewer tourists are booking long-haul flights this autumn. What does “airfare” mean?
qs.say: Airlines have raised airfares because of rising fuel costs. As a result, fewer tourists are booking long-haul flights this autumn.
qs.vi: Các hãng hàng không tăng giá vé máy bay do chi phí nhiên liệu tăng. Vì vậy ít du khách đặt chuyến bay đường dài hơn vào mùa thu này.
qs.why: airfare = giá vé máy bay.

sections.title: Nói vận dụng
sections.note: Bấm ghi âm và trả lời bằng tiếng Anh, cố dùng các từ gợi ý; trang sẽ chấm ước tính 4 tiêu chí.

qs.s: Describe the way you were brought up. Were your parents strict, and what were you allowed to do when you were in your teens?
qs.vi: Hãy mô tả cách bạn được nuôi dạy. Bố mẹ bạn có nghiêm khắc không, và bạn được phép làm gì khi ở tuổi thiếu niên?
qs.why: Kể ngắn về lúc nhỏ (toddler), rồi nêu quy tắc của bố mẹ, điều được phép và không được phép khi tuổi teen, cuối cùng nêu cảm nghĩ.
qs.sample: I was brought up by my parents in a small town. When I was a toddler, I used to toddle after my father in the garden. My parents were quite strict, because they did not allow me to use my phone during meals. When I was in my teens, I was allowed to go out with friends, but I could never stay out late. At the time I found it annoying, but now I understand that they simply wanted to keep me safe.

qs.s: Tell me about someone in your family or workplace. How old are they, and what are they like?
qs.vi: Hãy kể về một người trong gia đình hoặc nơi làm việc của bạn. Họ bao nhiêu tuổi và họ là người thế nào?
qs.why: Nêu tuổi bằng cách nói ước chừng (early/mid/late, almost, roughly), rồi mô tả tính cách và công việc của họ.
qs.sample: My manager is middle-aged, I think he is roughly forty-eight, although nobody asks him directly. His assistant is in her early thirties, and she has worked here for approximately five years. Most of the engineers are in their late twenties, while the accountant is in his mid-thirties and almost ready to start his own business. I enjoy working with such a mixed team, because younger colleagues bring energy and older ones share experience, which means we learn from each other every day.

qs.s: Do you think people today live longer than in the past? Talk about health problems that can threaten life.
qs.vi: Bạn có nghĩ ngày nay con người sống lâu hơn trước không? Hãy nói về những bệnh có thể đe dọa tính mạng.
qs.why: Nêu ý kiến (có/không), đưa lý do (y học, vắc-xin) và ví dụ một bệnh như viêm gan, kết bằng dự đoán tương lai.
qs.sample: I believe people live longer than before, because medicine has improved a lot. A century ago, many children would die from simple infections, and a middle-aged person was often considered old. Today vaccines protect us against diseases such as hepatitis, which damages the liver. Of course, some people are still unlucky, and it is sad when a relative is found dead in an accident or from illness. However, if we keep a healthy lifestyle, we can stay alive and active much longer.

qs.s: Tell me about a time when you had to manage a difficult task or project. What strategy did you use?
qs.vi: Hãy kể về lần bạn phải quản lý một nhiệm vụ hoặc dự án khó. Bạn đã dùng chiến lược nào?
qs.why: Kể bối cảnh, vấn đề, cách bạn xây dựng chiến lược, rồi kết quả; dùng managed to cho điều bạn đã làm được.
qs.sample: Last year I had to manage a group project at university, which was quite stressful. At the first meeting, nobody wanted to bring up the problem that we had too little time. So we decided to develop an effective strategy: we divided the work, set weekly goals and checked our progress every Friday. Thanks to this plan, we managed to finish two days early. The teacher said our presentation was smart and well organised, and I felt proud of the whole team.

qs.s: How important is it to dress well at work or at school? Describe what people usually wear in your country.
qs.vi: Việc ăn mặc chỉnh tề ở nơi làm việc hoặc ở trường quan trọng đến mức nào? Hãy mô tả người ta thường mặc gì ở nước bạn.
qs.why: Nêu quan điểm, mô tả trang phục thường thấy (áo top, vest), so sánh công sở với trường học và kết luận.
qs.sample: In my opinion, it is important to look smart at work, because first impressions matter. In most offices in my country, people are well-dressed: men wear a shirt and trousers, and women wear a simple top with a skirt. When we meet clients, everyone is smartly dressed in dark colors. At university, however, students are more relaxed and often wear jeans. Although comfortable clothes are fine, I think a neat appearance helps people feel confident and be taken seriously.

qs.s: Describe a job that involves transporting people or goods. Why is it important for society?
qs.vi: Hãy mô tả một nghề liên quan đến vận chuyển người hoặc hàng hóa. Vì sao nó quan trọng với xã hội?
qs.why: Chọn một nghề (phi công, tài xế), nêu việc họ làm, hàng hóa chở (barley...) và vì sao xã hội cần.
qs.sample: One job that I really admire is a lorry driver, because the whole economy depends on them. Every morning a lorry carries barley from the farms to a factory, where it is turned into beer and bread. A small van then delivers the final products to local shops. In a similar way, a pilot carries hundreds of passengers safely across the world. These workers often have long hours, which means they deserve more respect, because without them our shelves would be empty.

qs.s: How do you usually travel, and do you think transport is too expensive? Talk about a trip you took recently.
qs.vi: Bạn thường đi lại bằng gì và có nghĩ giao thông quá đắt không? Hãy nói về một chuyến đi gần đây.
qs.why: Nói phương tiện thường dùng, nhận xét giá vé, rồi kể chuyến đi gần đây theo trình tự lên xe, xuống xe.
qs.sample: I usually catch the bus to university, and the bus fare has gone up recently, which is annoying. Last month I wanted to catch the train to visit my aunt, but the airfare was cheaper, so I decided to go by plane and fly instead. I almost forgot my ticket, and if I had missed the plane I would have been in trouble. I got on the shuttle bus, then got off at the terminal. Afterwards I got into a taxi, and finally I got out of it in front of her house.

qs.s: Do you think roads in your city are safe? Talk about traffic rules and a time you lost your way while traveling.
qs.vi: Bạn có nghĩ đường phố ở thành phố bạn an toàn không? Hãy nói về luật giao thông và một lần bạn bị lạc đường khi đi.
qs.why: Nêu ý kiến về an toàn, nói về luật tốc độ và vượt xe, rồi kể một lần đi lạc và kết quả ended up.
qs.sample: I think roads in my city are not very safe, because many drivers ignore the speed limit. On the motorway, motorbikes often overtake lorries on both sides, even where there is a no overtaking sign. Last year I took a side road to avoid a traffic jam, but I took a wrong turn and ended up in a small village. Although I was lost, a friendly farmer showed me the way, so I learned that sometimes a mistake can lead to a pleasant surprise.

qs.s: How do you prepare for an exam? Talk about the equipment you use and how you deal with new words.
qs.vi: Bạn chuẩn bị cho một kỳ thi như thế nào? Hãy nói về dụng cụ bạn dùng và cách bạn xử lý từ mới.
qs.why: Kể quy trình ôn thi: dụng cụ (gọt bút chì), cách tra từ, thói quen khi sắp thi và cảm giác của bạn.
qs.sample: When I take an exam, I like to prepare early. As a pupil, I had to study up to ten subjects, so I made a weekly timetable. On the exam day I carry two pencils and a pencil sharpener, because I sharpen my pencil whenever the point breaks. When I read an unfamiliar word in practice tests, I look up its meaning in an online dictionary and write an example sentence. This routine keeps me calm, which means I can concentrate better during the test.

qs.s: Compare the school system in your country with another one. What happens after students leave school?
qs.vi: Hãy so sánh hệ thống trường học ở nước bạn với một nước khác. Điều gì xảy ra sau khi học sinh rời trường?
qs.why: Đi theo các cấp học (nursery, primary, secondary), so sánh công lập và tư thục, rồi nói về lựa chọn sau khi tốt nghiệp.
qs.sample: In my country, state education is free until the age of sixteen. Most families send their children to a state school, which is operated by the local government, although some prefer a private school. Children attend nursery school at three, primary school at six and secondary school at eleven. After that, some students stay at school until eighteen and go on to university, whereas others leave school to take vocational training and get a job quickly. In my view, both paths are valuable.
